This produces suboptimal query performance at scale. Resolve the issue by replacing \`auth.<function>()\` with \`(select auth.<function>())\`. lints.name: multiple_permissive_policies
lints.title: Multiple Permissive Policies
lints.description: Detects if multiple permissive row level security policies are present on a table for the same \`role\` and \`action\` (e.g. insert). Multiple permissive policies are suboptimal for performance as each policy must be executed for every relevant query.

findings.detail: Table \`public.app_settings\` has multiple permissive policies for role \`authenticated\` for action \`SELECT\`. Policies include \`{app_settings_select_admin,app_settings_write_admin}\`
Table \`public.districts\` has multiple permissive policies for role \`anon\` for action \`SELECT\`. Policies include \`{"Anyone can read districts",districts_select_public_active}\`
